normalized_request: Build ShopPilot — a single-merchant, Thai-market B2C storefront plus an admin back office covering the full business flow (browse -> cart -> checkout -> pay -> fulfil -> track), with banking-grade governance (PDPA B.E. 2562, Revenue Code retention, Consumer Protection Act, PCI-DSS scope-excluded via a tokenizing mock PSP).

human_gates: S1b ba-breakdown three-amigos (sync NAMED quorum — BA + dev + QA leads)
S2 tl-design (sync NAMED, Tech Lead + governance)
S6 release-handoff (sync NAMED, Release Manager — irreversible)
S7 prod-validate (sync, On-call / Release Mgr — rollback decision)

contract.business_goal: Let customers buy end-to-end on the web and let admins run catalog, stock and orders from one back office.
in_scope: customer auth (register/login/refresh/logout) with PDPA-lawful credential handling
server-computed checkout totals, one coupon, shipping rule, idempotent confirm
mock payment capture with provider-replay safety
orders with frozen price snapshot + own-data-only tracking
stock reservation lifecycle + audited admin adjustments
out_of_scope: real payment provider / stored card data

nfrs.target: PDPA: PII encrypted at rest; ap-southeast residency; 5y Revenue-Code retention
TBD-confirm-with-PM (see OQ-1) — order-confirm p95 numeric threshold not stated

open_questions.question: Numeric SLO thresholds for order-confirm p95 and order-listing latency?
Abandoned-cart handling beyond the 30-day purge (notify vs silent)?

assumptions: Mock PSP and mock courier stand in for real providers for the MVP.
Single market (Thai) and single language pairing (th/en) for the MVP.
